BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Remote input is concatenated into an XPath expression.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Quote characters in the input are enough to alter the expression.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The vulnerable endpoint is reachable without authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The attacker sends the request directly; no victim action is needed.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The query runs against the same application XML data.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Altered expressions can return the entire XML document.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: XPath queries read data and cannot modify it.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
